'''''The Republic Journal of Law-Enforcement and Low-Intensity Conflict''''' was a forum for scholarly analysis of non-war conflict. With the [[Declaration of a New Order]], ''The Republic Journal of Law-Enforcement and Low-Intensity Conflict'' published analysis of events which undermined [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] doctrine and, as a result, was forced underground. Nevertheless, it continued to publish the ''[[Threat Dossier]]'' newsletter, detailing individuals of interest to the Journal and distributing it freely to interested parties. The Journal found a new audience with members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
